Game Overview

In Yenemy, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Yenemy doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Yenemy?

Yenemy is a free io game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Yenemy free to play?

Yes, Yenemy is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
